Container.Name: TLCDashboard-Production
Container.Overview: TLCDashboard Production repository template. Use only after separate production approval and verification that the stable image contains the deployment guard. Choose dedicated production storage and credentials; never reuse development mounts. Production Promotions is not supported. Managed Phase B requires the legacy integration fields below to remain blank.
Container.Requires: linux/amd64 on Unraid. Use existing verified storage markers and HTTPS. One Gunicorn worker with four threads and one scheduler; preserve image defaults for lease, request, runtime and readback limits. Automatic publishing remains off.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: TLCDashboard web interface. Keep the container port; choose an unused host port. Use the existing HTTPS proxy for managed sessions.

Config.Name: Application Data
Config.Description: Persistent SQLite, users, orders, inventory, BOMs, operations, publishing receipts and database backups. Select a dedicated production path for this role; never use a development mount.

Config.Name: Product Catalogue
Config.Description: Collection folders, shared and product JSON, source images and scanner identity markers. Select a dedicated production path for this role; never use a development mount.

Config.Name: Generated Output
Config.Description: Generated files and image output; separate from private customer photos in Cloudflare R2. Select a dedicated production path for this role; never use a development mount.

Config.Name: Catalogue Intake
Config.Description: Optional separate host directory for loose and prepared product images. Select a dedicated production path for this role; never use a development mount.

Config.Name: Taxonomy Registry
Config.Description: Optional separate authoritative registry.json directory and verified registry backups. Select a dedicated production path for this role; never use a development mount.

Config.Name: Catalogue Container Root
Config.Description: Keep the container mount destination, not the host path.

Config.Name: Output Container Root
Config.Description: Keep the container mount destination, not the host path.

Config.Name: Intake Container Root
Config.Description: Keep the container mount destination, not the host path.

Config.Name: Taxonomy Root
Config.Description: Keep the container mount destination, not the host path.

Config.Name: Public Image URL Prefix
Config.Description: Public HTTP(S) generated-image base; use a trailing slash for a directory. Not a Cloudflare private-upload endpoint.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: UID used by the application process. Match host permissions.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: GID used by the application process. Match host permissions.

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Octal permissions mask for newly created files.

Config.Name: Container Timezone
Config.Description: Container process timezone. UK Orders, shipping and promotion date handling stays Europe/London.

Config.Name: SECRET_KEY
Config.Description: Strong Flask session key. Retain the existing value when updating; use a separate random value for a new environment.

Config.Name: Deployment Environment
Config.Description: Fixed role; do not change or remove the deployment identity guard.

Config.Name: Deployment Storage Identity
Config.Description: Existing 32-character lowercase hexadecimal storage ID that matches every mounted role marker. Never reuse the other environment’s ID.

Config.Name: Deployment Shopify Domain
Config.Description: Enter the independently verified permanent production myshopify.com domain. Must match the Shopify Store Domain below.

Config.Name: Deployment Shopify Shop ID
Config.Description: Expected Shopify Shop GID verified during managed startup.

Config.Name: Deployment Shopify Product App ID
Config.Description: Expected Product app GID, not the Promotions app or a client ID.

Config.Name: Permit Managed Shopify Writes
Config.Description: Default off for a fresh template. Preserve the separately approved live value in an existing container. This never replaces reviewed operation approval.

Config.Name: Permit Managed Shopify Automation
Config.Description: Keep off. Requires separate write permission and an explicit in-dashboard publishing grant. Does not disable signed manual work.

Config.Name: Shopify Store Domain
Config.Description: Permanent shop-name.myshopify.com domain matching the deployment identity. Use only this environment’s installed Product app.

Config.Name: Shopify Admin API Token
Config.Description: Optional alternative to the complete Product app client pair. Leave blank in client-credentials mode.

Config.Name: Shopify API Version
Config.Description: Blank uses 2026-10 for normal calls. Do not set 2027-01 here; the opt-in packed dimensions and Y081 paths select that version themselves.

Config.Name: Shopify Client ID
Config.Description: Product app Client ID. Supply with Client Secret and leave Admin API Token blank. Not the Promotions Client ID.

Config.Name: Shopify Client Secret
Config.Description: Product app secret for the client-credentials mode. Keep Admin API Token blank.

Config.Name: Enable Native Packed Dimensions
Config.Description: Default off. Opt-in 2027-01 release-candidate packed dimensions require verified capability, write_inventory and a reviewed assignment. Never substitutes finished dimensions.

Config.Name: Product Dimension Metafield Namespace
Config.Description: Keep the existing namespace for typed finished dimensions. Not a shipping package or packed dimensions.

Config.Name: Default Country of Origin
Config.Description: Optional uppercase two-letter manufacturing-origin default. Empty preserves fallback; authored catalogue values win.

Config.Name: Default Requires Shipping
Config.Description: Optional true/false. Empty preserves fallback; authored catalogue values win.

Config.Name: Default Manage Stock
Config.Description: Optional true/false. Empty preserves fallback; authored catalogue values win.

Config.Name: Default Backorders
Config.Description: Optional no, yes or notify. Empty preserves fallback; authored catalogue values win.

Config.Name: Orders Initial History Days
Config.Description: Bounded initial read-only Orders history; subject to app access.

Config.Name: Orders Batch Size
Config.Description: Bounded Orders page size. Keep the application default unless needed.

Config.Name: Orders Startup Catch-up
Config.Description: Kept off. Managed startup forces false; manual Orders Sync Now is separate.

Config.Name: Customer Photo Worker URL
Config.Description: Optional. Use the exact HTTPS origin of this environment’s separate Worker, without a trailing slash. Supply all three photo settings together or leave all blank.

Config.Name: Customer Photo Worker Token
Config.Description: Optional. The DASHBOARD_UPLOAD_TOKEN of this environment’s Worker, not a Shopify or R2 credential. Never reuse the other environment’s token.

Config.Name: Customer Photo Proxy Path
Config.Description: Optional. Exact installed Shopify storefront app-proxy path for this shop. The Worker must prove this path and shop before publishing a photo field or binding/downloading an Order photo.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Online Store Navigation Publication ID
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Exact verified Online Store Publication GID used for navigation only; not a product publication override.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Orders Webhook Queue URL
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Optional outbound encrypted Orders queue origin, not the dashboard or photo Worker.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Orders Webhook Queue Token
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Outbound queue credential.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Orders Webhook Encryption Key
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Outbound queue encryption key.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Orders Webhook HMAC Secret
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Shopify event HMAC secret for encrypted queue verification.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Orders Webhook Store Domain
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Canonical shop domain expected by the separate Orders webhook queue.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Orders Webhook Store ID
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Expected Shopify Shop GID for the separate Orders webhook queue.

Config.Name: Legacy only: WooCommerce Store URL
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Optional WooCommerce HTTPS origin.

Config.Name: Legacy only: WooCommerce Consumer Key
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. WooCommerce REST API Consumer Key.

Config.Name: Legacy only: WooCommerce Consumer Secret
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. WooCommerce REST API Consumer Secret.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Discord Scanner Updates Webhook
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Optional scanner lifecycle webhook.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Discord Scanner Warnings and Failures Webhook
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Optional scanner errors and warnings webhook.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Discord Metadata Updates Webhook
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Optional collection metadata and override update webhook.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Discord Product Overrides Webhook
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Optional product override webhook.

Config.Name: Legacy only: Discord Product Ingest Webhook
Config.Description: Leave blank on managed deployments; the startup guard rejects nonempty values. Optional high-volume per-product ingestion webhook.

Config.Name: Enable Discord Notifications
Config.Description: Off by default. Keep off in managed deployments; webhook credentials are rejected.

Config.Name: Discord Display Name
Config.Description: Optional display name for legacy notification embeds.

Config.Name: Discord Avatar URL
Config.Description: Optional public avatar URL for legacy notifications.

Config.Name: Discord Field Character Limit
Config.Description: Legacy Discord embed bound. Does not affect publishing.

Config.Name: Discord Embed Field Limit
Config.Description: Legacy Discord embed bound. Does not affect publishing.
